attchmntText: NMDC Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: NMDC Limited filed a corporate investors presentation regarding its performance for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The company reported iron ore production of 121.55 lakh tonnes in the second quarter of fiscal year 2027, representing a 19% increase compared to the corresponding period in the previous year. Sales volume reached 104.83 lakh tonnes, a 2% decline from the prior year period. Profit after tax stood at 1,667 crore rupees, down 2% year-over-year. Revenue from operations totaled 6,638 crore rupees, showing a 6% growth. Average iron ore sales realization was 5,488 rupees per tonne, up 10% from the previous year. For the first half of fiscal year 2027, production increased by 23% to 230 lakh tonnes, while sales rose by 0.1% to 222.13 lakh tonnes. Profit after tax for the half-year was 3,674 crore rupees, a 0.3% increase. The presentation includes detailed financial metrics and shareholder data as of 30th September 2026.

attchmntText: NMDC Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: NMDC Limited reported integrated financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026, approved by the Board on 12th November 2026. Standalone profit for the quarter was INR 1,666.67 crore, compared to INR 1,694.42 crore in the same period last year. Half-year standalone profit stood at INR 3,673.94 crore versus INR 3,663.04 crore previously. Standalone revenue from operations was INR 6,638.23 crore for the quarter and INR 13,433.48 crore for the half year. The auditor's report highlights contingent liabilities including INR 16,188.56 crore for Karnataka mineral taxes, INR 1,501.39 crore and INR 4,921.06 crore from NMDC Steel Limited, and INR 5,564.88 crore from Rashtriya Ispat Nigam Limited. Other matters include sub-judice demands of INR 1,623.44 crore and INR 1,620.50 crore.

attchmntText: NMDC Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: NMDC Limited has opened a special one-year window for the transfer and dematerialization of physical securities. This window is active from February 05, 2026 to February 04, 2027. It applies to securities sold or purchased prior to April 1, 2019. It also covers transfer requests that were previously rejected, returned, or unattended. All transferred securities must be credited in dematerialized form. A lock-in period of one year applies from the date of registration of transfer. During this period, securities cannot be transferred, pledged, or lien-marked. Investors must submit requests to Registrar and Transfer Agent M/s Aarthi Consultants Pvt Ltd in Hyderabad. The notice was published in Financial Express and Vaartha newspapers on November 11, 2026.
